request: Substring ranges whose stop position precedes their start position must be rejected with the stop-position error. Valid ranges must return the corresponding substring using character positions, while out-of-bounds start and stop positions must produce their respective position errors.

defects.description: Published bug fixed upstream: fix(stringx): reject start > stop in Substr to prevent slice panic (#5616)

trigger.input:
printf %s '' | base64 -d > core/stringx/strings_test.go
if go test -count=1 -run '^(TestSubstr)$' ./core/stringx >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo probe: pass; else echo probe: fail; fi

defects.why_missed: The project's own suite at the parent commit never exercised this input; the fix commit added the test that does.
